preventable: SOP-SCM-004 Rev 5 §6.2 (quoted): "On the effective date, and before the assessment in section 7 begins: - All unused material from that supplier is placed in quarantine, physically and in the inventory system, irrespective of its own test results and irrespective of any prior release decision recorded against it. ... - Goods receipt is blocked against the supplier. Material received from a supplier on or after their disqualification date should not have been accepted; where such a receipt has occurred it is quarantined on discovery and a deviation is raised..." (source: sop:SOP-SCM-004 Rev 5#6. Disqualification > 6.2 Immediate actions).

Material-level findings from the assessment: material received after disqualification: mrd_erp.material_lots#MLOT-2606-0055; material in stock not quarantined (assessment list): MLOT-2402-0097, MLOT-2405-0047, MLOT-2405-0039, MLOT-2406-0002, MLOT-2407-0048, MLOT-2501-0106, MLOT-2501-0053, MLOT-2503-0042, MLOT-2505-0092, MLOT-2506-0100, MLOT-2506-0044, MLOT-2506-0108, MLOT-2603-0070, MLOT-2606-0055 (source: mrd_erp.material_lots entries returned by the supplier impact assessment).

escalate.reason: Material from SUP-04 was received after the 2026-05-20 disqualification date and multiple supplier material lots remain recorded in stock without quarantine; SOP-SCM-004 §6.2 requires preventive quarantine and a deviation where receipts occurred after disqualification.

preventable:
MATERIAL_RECEIVED_AFTER_DISQUALIFICATION — evidence: mrd_erp.material_lots#MLOT-2606-0055; governing requirement (SOP-SCM-004 Rev 5 §6.2 Immediate actions) quoted: "On the effective date, and before the assessment in section 7 begins:

- **All unused material from that supplier is placed in quarantine**, physically
  and in the inventory system, irrespective of its own test results and
  irrespective of any prior release decision recorded against it. A material lot
  that has passed its own incoming testing is not thereby exempt: the basis of
  the disqualification is the supplier, not the consignment.
- **Goods receipt is blocked** against the supplier. Material received from a
  supplier on or after their disqualification date should not have been
  accepted; where such a receipt has occurred it is quarantined on discovery and
  a deviation is raised under SOP-QA-007 against the receipt itself, separately
  from any deviation raised against the material.
- **Open production orders** drawing on that supplier's material are suspended
  pending the assessment."

MATERIAL_IN_STOCK_NOT_QUARANTINED — evidence: mrd_erp.material_lots#MLOT-2402-0097,mrd_erp.material_lots#MLOT-2405-0047,mrd_erp.material_lots#MLOT-2405-0039,mrd_erp.material_lots#MLOT-2406-0002,mrd_erp.material_lots#MLOT-2407-0048,mrd_erp.material_lots#MLOT-2501-0106,mrd_erp.material_lots#MLOT-2501-0053,mrd_erp.material_lots#MLOT-2503-0042,mrd_erp.material_lots#MLOT-2505-0092,mrd_erp.material_lots#MLOT-2506-0100,mrd_erp.material_lots#MLOT-2506-0044,mrd_erp.material_lots#MLOT-2506-0108,mrd_erp.material_lots#MLOT-2603-0070,mrd_erp.material_lots#MLOT-2606-0055; governing requirement (SOP-SCM-004 Rev 5 §6.2 Immediate actions) quoted above.

- **Goods receipt is blocked** against the supplier. Material received from a
  supplier on or after their disqualification date should not have been
  accepted; where such a receipt has occurred it is quarantined on discovery and
  a deviation is raised under SOP-QA-007 against the receipt itself, separately
  from any deviation raised against the material.
- **Open production orders** drawing on that supplier's material are suspended
  pending the assessment.

The quarantine in this section is preventive and is not a finding about the
material. It is applied first because it is the only action in this procedure
that becomes impossible once the material is consumed."
